lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate part 8 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a young used-car flipper growing his capital from one hundred thousand roubles. This time he deals with school teachers. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «Эволюшн» is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: confident, a bit cheeky, showing his phone to a teacher. Line 2: suddenly honest and warm, a little embarrassed.

ildar.profile: Ildar — an energetic Russian school PE teacher in his 30s in a tracksuit and a white cap, loud and cheerful, calls everyone «брат».
ildar.notes: One line: loud, proud, like a PE teacher at a school assembly.

lev.profile: Lev Markovich — a strict, pedantic Russian maths teacher in his 60s with glasses and a moustache, slow, precise, slightly pompous.
lev.notes: Line 1: strict teacher calling a student to the blackboard, then very sure of himself. Line 2: after a pause, reluctantly impressed, short and dry, like grading a student.

egor.profile: Egorych — a kind, simple Russian school labour teacher in his 60s in a blue work coat, gruff warm voice, proud of his old car.
egor.notes: Line 1: proud, simple, patting his old car. Line 2: stunned, touched, disbelieving.

dir.profile: Viktor Andreevich — a polite, formal Russian school headmaster in his 50s in a suit, a bit pompous, official tone.
dir.notes: One line: formal and polite, a small pause before «коллективная заявка», said officially.
